I walked in here because I use my 30-baht universal healthcare coverage. This led me to meet a female doctor who was very helpful and unhurried in her consultations, despite the fact that her time is very valuable. I've been getting dental work done for half my life and this is the first time I've found such a good, gentle, and kind doctor. I'll definitely be entrusting my dental care to this clinic forever.

It's near the Airport Link Ratchaprarop station, but there's no parking.
